title: Range Sum Queries
statement:
You are given an array and several questions. Each question gives `l` and `r`; answer with the sum of `a_l ... a_r` (positions start at 1).

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `q`. The second line contains `n` integers. Each of the next `q` lines contains `l` and `r`.

## Output
For each question print the sum on its own line.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n, q <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
- `1 <= l <= r <= n`
